_comment: Extension compatibility manifest. contrib entries are fetched from the patched PostgreSQL tree at the .pgtags tag; external entries are cloned from their upstream repo at `tag`: "latest" (the default) resolves to the newest stable release at fetch time (optionally restricted by `tag_match`, ${PG_MAJOR} expands), a tag name or a 40-hex commit pins. The resolved version is recorded in the results. Nothing in any suite is modified.

extensions.name: amcheck
extensions.notes: verify_heapam is heap-specific; btree checks apply to bridged/heap indexes only

extensions.name: basic_archive
extensions.notes: needs archive_mode and archive_library (taken from its temp-config)

extensions.name: dblink
extensions.notes: suite loads regress.so via --dlpath; that library is only built inside the PostgreSQL source tree

extensions.name: pageinspect
extensions.notes: reads heap page layout; expected to diverge on OrioleDB tables

extensions.name: pg_freespacemap
extensions.notes: reads heap free space map; expected to diverge on OrioleDB tables

extensions.name: pg_stat_statements
extensions.notes: needs shared_preload_libraries (taken from its temp-config)

extensions.name: pg_surgery
extensions.notes: heap tuple surgery by TID; expected to diverge on OrioleDB tables

extensions.name: pg_visibility
extensions.notes: reads heap visibility map; expected to diverge on OrioleDB tables

extensions.name: pg_walinspect
extensions.notes: needs wal_level=replica (taken from its temp-config)

extensions.name: pgstattuple
extensions.notes: tuple-level heap statistics; expected to diverge on OrioleDB tables

extensions.name: sepgsql
extensions.notes: requires SELinux; not installable in the test images
extensions.skip: requires SELinux; not installable in the test images

extensions.name: test_decoding
extensions.notes: logical decoding through OrioleDB rm_decode; needs wal_level=logical (taken from its temp-config)

extensions.name: pgvector
extensions.notes: hnsw/ivfflat index AMs run through OrioleDB index bridging; same tag ci/post_build_prerequisites.sh installs

extensions.name: wal2json
extensions.notes: logical decoding output plugin; exercises OrioleDB rm_decode. The patched server has an output_plugin_libraries allow-list, so the plugin is listed there; same tag ci/post_build_prerequisites.sh installs

extensions.name: hypopg
extensions.notes: hypothetical indexes; also index_advisor's dependency

extensions.name: index_advisor
extensions.notes: suite is --use-existing; its CI creates contrib_regression and tablespace testts first (.github/workflows/test.yml)

extensions.name: http
extensions.notes: suite talks to httpbin.org / postgis.net / localhost:9080; network-dependent by design upstream

extensions.name: plpgsql_check
extensions.notes: tests LOAD the library themselves; not preloaded, as upstream installcheck

extensions.name: pg_cron
extensions.notes: shared_preload_libraries=pg_cron comes from its pg_cron.conf temp-config

extensions.name: pgaudit
extensions.notes: shared_preload_libraries=pgaudit comes from its pgaudit.conf temp-config; upstream pg_regress suite runs as-is; releases are per PostgreSQL major, so the newest tag for the server major is used

extensions.name: pg_partman
extensions.notes: pgTAP suite as its test/README_test.md describes: pg_prove over the top-level test-*.sql (each BEGIN...ROLLBACK), pgtap in public and pg_partman in schema partman, max_locks_per_transaction raised to 128 because the subpartitioning tests create hundreds of tables in one transaction; test_pg17plus/ and test_no_search_path/ run under the same rules. test_bgw/, test_procedure/, test_tablespace/, test_nonsuperuser/, test_manual/ need manual staging per that README and are not run. Also pgmq's dependency

extensions.name: pgmq
extensions.notes: pure-SQL queue; partitioned-queue tests use pg_partman; also ships isolation specs that this harness does not run

extensions.name: pgtap
extensions.notes: its own `make installcheck` (generated parallel schedule under test/build/, every test wrapped by test/setup.sql); EXTRA_REGRESS_OPTS carries --load-extension=orioledb as pgxs allows. extension.sql needs contrib citext/isn/ltree, present in the image. Also the test dependency of pg_partman, pgjwt, pgsodium, vault

extensions.name: pgsodium
extensions.notes: pgTAP suite as its test.sh runs it: pg_prove test/test.sql (one file that \ir-includes the others, BEGIN...ROLLBACK). Upstream runs it under three server configs; this is the plain one (no preload), the preloaded one is exercised by supabase_vault's server. Also vault's dependency (libsodium)

extensions.name: pgjwt
extensions.notes: pure-SQL JWT; pgTAP suite as its test.sh runs it: pg_prove test.sql (creates pgcrypto, pgtap, pgjwt itself). Upstream has no release tags, so pinned to a commit

extensions.name: supabase_vault
extensions.notes: mirrors its CI (nix/withTmpDb.sh.in): preload pgsodium+supabase_vault with a zero-key getkey script, createdb contrib_regression, load test/fixtures.sql, then installcheck (a pgTAP test run through pg_regress)

extensions.name: pg_graphql
extensions.notes: Rust/pgrx (cargo-pgrx 0.16.1); runs the suite exactly as its bin/installcheck does: createdb contrib_regression, psql test/fixtures.sql, pg_regress --use-existing over test/sql

extensions.name: pg_jsonschema
extensions.notes: Rust/pgrx; upstream tests are #[pg_test] functions that start their own server, so this is a smoke check from ci/ext/smoke/ (CREATE EXTENSION plus each documented function over an orioledb table)

extensions.name: wrappers
extensions.notes: Rust/pgrx workspace built with only the helloworld_fdw feature; no SQL suite upstream, so this is a smoke check from ci/ext/smoke/ following its helloworld_fdw README

extensions.name: pg_net
extensions.notes: async HTTP worker (libcurl, shared_preload_libraries=pg_net). Upstream suite is pytest behind nix-provisioned nginx and pathod servers, so this is a smoke check from ci/ext/smoke/: a request to a closed local port, the worker writing its response row into the orioledb-backed net tables; the worker serves one database (pg_net.database_name), so it is pointed at the suite's database

extensions.name: postgis
extensions.notes: autotools build against the image's GEOS/PROJ/GDAL/SFCGAL/protobuf-c, then its own `make installcheck-base` (regress/run_test.pl --extension over core, loader, dumper, raster, topology, sfcgal, followed by the upgrade pass upstream runs after it, reported as upgrade__*). GiST indexes go through OrioleDB index bridging
